cohort: The study included 88 fetuses examined between 2011-2018 at a tertiary referral medical center.
finding: There is a statistically significant, though not perfect, agreement among different prenatal clinically used modalities for measuring fetal brain and the head circumference at birth.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at the time of fetal US and brain MRI acquisition was approximately 34.4-34.6 weeks.
